title: element-closest-polyfill 1.0.7: ISC, with no copyright holder upstream

components.name: element-closest-polyfill
components.statement: element-closest-polyfill 1.0.7 (by idmadj) declares the ISC licence; no copyright holder is named in the package or its repository.
components.evidence: package.json "license": "ISC", no author field; the package has only index.js, package.json, README.md (npm tarball, integrity = lockfile, unpacks identical to node_modules). Upstream idmadj/element-closest-polyfill at the npm gitHead 3163c54cfe6789bf4eadcffe73689476eeb0dd83 has no LICENSE (tree: .gitignore, .npmignore, README.md, index.js, index.test.js, package-lock.json, package.json). The npm maintainer and publisher is 'idmadj' (registry metadata). The README says it uses MDN's implementation (MDN code samples added after 20 Aug 2010 are CC0; not checked for this snippet). ISC text: SPDX License List v3.29.0 (commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48) text/ISC.txt, the text for the SPDX id package.json uses; it carries a template line 'Copyright <year> <owner>' that is not a holder (copyright: [] = none upstream).
